indicators.name: Urgent Payment / High-Pressure Demand
indicators.description: Payment requested with extreme urgency or strict time constraints (e.g., 'send within 5 minutes').
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged if communication or transaction note contains urgency keywords or high velocity demand.

indicators.name: Unverified Identity Claim
indicators.description: Recipient claims to be a relative, executive, bank official, or government entity without secondary verification.
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged when sender notes or reports indicate an identity assertion not backed by verified account credentials.

indicators.name: First-Time Recipient Account
indicators.description: The sender has never transferred money to this recipient phone number before.
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged if transaction history between sender and recipient is 0.

indicators.name: Unusual Payment Amount
indicators.description: Transaction amount is significantly higher than sender's average transfer or exceeds typical P2P thresholds.
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged if amount > 3x average user transaction or > 5,000 ETB for new recipient.

indicators.name: Multiple Fraud Reports
indicators.description: Recipient phone number has accumulated 3 or more independent user fraud reports.

indicators.name: Recent Fraud Report Activity
indicators.description: Recipient received new fraud reports within the last 7 to 14 days, indicating an active ongoing campaign.

indicators.name: Connected to Flagged Accounts / Graph Cluster
indicators.description: Recipient shares linked bank accounts, device IDs, or rapid money transfers with known fraudulent entities.
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged if recipient relationship graph connects to flagged nodes within 2 hops.

indicators.name: Linked to Previous Scam Cases
indicators.description: Recipient has been formally implicated in an investigated fraud case or intelligence record.
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged if count of linked scam_cases >= 1.

indicators.name: Advance Payment Demand for Goods
indicators.description: Seller requires 100% or partial mobile payment before meeting or sending delivery.
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged when payment is classified under e-commerce or fake seller reporting.

indicators.name: OTP / PIN Solicitation Attempt
indicators.description: Recipient or associated channel explicitly requested the victim's SMS OTP, PIN, or verification code.
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged if report indicates OTP/PIN was solicited.

indicators.name: Fake Credit Notification Precursor
indicators.description: Recipient engaged in fake SMS credit notification followed by immediate phone call requesting a refund.
indicators.eval_rule: Flagged if victim reported spoofed SMS credit message.

indicators.name: Newly Created Payment Account (<30 days)
indicators.description: Payment wallet or bank account was registered very recently, typical of throwaway scam accounts.
